errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the color of the bars for the 60% of median wage; they are blue, not gray.

errors.text_span: die einen sind lila und stellen den gesetzlichen Mindestlohn dar
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the purple bars represent the statutory minimum wage. Purple bars represent 60% of the median wage.

errors.text_span: Der gesetzliche Mindestlohn beträgt von 2015 bis 2025 10,59, 12,80, 13,93, 12,82, 13,69 bzw. Euro pro Stunde.
errors.evidence: Values given for statutory minimum wage in the description do not match with those in the chart: correct values are 8.50, 8.84, 9.19, 9.35, 9.60, 10.52, 12.00, 12.82 (for 2024) etc.

errors.text_span: Der 60 %-ige Medianlohn der Vollzeitbeschäftigten beträgt von 2015 bis 2025 8,50, 9,35, 9,55, 9,60, 9,71 bzw. Euro pro Stunde.
errors.evidence: Values given for the 60% median wage in the description do not match with those in the chart: correct values are 10.59, 10.82, 10.92, 11.42, 11.80, etc.
The description does not mention the striped pattern for the bars corresponding to 2024 and 2025.
The description does not fully state the chart purpose which is to compare the actual minimum wage and the reference-compatible minimum wage.
